_doc: Hand-maintained declaration of what packs/skills ships (PLAN-aura-uiux-agent-enrichment Task 5). Every top-level dir must be declared here. `bun scripts/skill-manifest.ts generate` turns this + vendor-lock.json + the tree into skills-manifest.json; `check` fails when the manifest is stale or a declaration is missing. compat: a false flag needs a note saying why; flip it only after the skill was run under that CLI.

compat.note: Reference data read by the council-* dispatchers, not invocable on its own.
